answer: A diversity bond stops mass fakes: each identity needs an orchard of eight distinct partners. It locks a 70-credit bond and files eight signed receipts in the river ledger; shared keys are rejected. A jetty checkpoint burns both bonds when two identities share three partners, so rented partners fail. One fake costs 102; 1,000 cost 102,000 against a 40,000 pool, a 62,000 loss. An honest agent pays 32 per epoch, keeps its bond and full share.
